invariants.rationale: The method immediately casts context, so it must not be null.
instantTime is passed to an executor and used as an identifier, so should not be null.
instantTime likely encodes a commit instant, so should be non-empty.
preppedRecords is passed to another class; null likely indicates no work, which may be invalid.
If preppedRecords is not empty, its first element should be non-null.
